description: On the green bed surface in front of you, there’s a white pedestal-like piece with a round knob on top and a separate white cup-shaped cover beside it. The left hand slides forward to steady the pedestal while the right hand reaches to the cup-shaped cover, lifts it up, moves it left over the round knob, and lowers it straight down to cap the knob; both hands then release, leaving the cover resting on the pedestal.
